general.name: Docker - Update Expected Containers [Lin]
general.description: Shows or changes this host's Docker expected-containers list and ignore patterns; keeps the previous file as .prev. Changes no container. https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components

variables.name: usrAction
variables.description: Show the lists and how they compare; accept what runs now as the list; add or remove entries; add or remove ignore patterns.

variables.name: usrItems
variables.description: For Add/Remove: container names, name:<name> or compose:<project>/<service>, space or comma separated. For the ignore actions: regexes, space separated.
